responsibility: This header declares the primary diagnostic API for the mc front end. It defines the opaque mcError_error handle and exports routines for immediate internal errors, token-based formatted errors and warnings, creation and chaining of diagnostic records, attaching prebuilt DynamicStrings messages, and flushing or aborting on accumulated diagnostics, forming the public contract for compiler error reporting.
same_name_distinction: Declares the opaque mcError_error handle and the public routines for creating, formatting, chaining, flushing, and aborting diagnostics. Unlike GmcError.cc, it provides the external contract only, not the buffered error structures or reporting implementation.
